hints.title: Customer Order Counter and Price Lookup
hints.text: Maintain an incremental counter of customers served and map product identifiers directly to their prices.

hints.title: Modulo Discount Application
hints.text: When customer count modulo n equals 0, scale the bill total by (100 - discount) / 100.

hints.title: Cashier State Blueprint
hints.text: Store price_map[product_id]. Increment count in getBill. Sum prices times quantities. If count % n == 0, multiply sum by (1 - discount / 100).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: M: number of purchased items in order
complexity.notes: Price map allows direct O(1) unit price lookup for each ordered item.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear product scans for each item in an order lead to O(M * P) query time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Key-value price index provides O(1) item price resolution.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Clean hash map construction and accurate floating point discount calculation.

solutions.approach: Product Price Map with Modulo Counter
